claim: Dryad is an external nonprofit data repository committed to making research data available for reuse and preservation.
future_grounding_route: Dryad datasets can be queued for intake only after license, file manifest, metadata, and biological relevance are verified by project scripts.
project_use: General research-data discovery route for publication-linked MS datasets.
unique_knowledge_lacks_in_repo: Curated publication-linked research datasets with preservation/reuse focus outside specialist biomedical archives.
why_unverifiable: Dryad deposits are external and heterogeneous; specific data files require project-controlled acquisition and grounding.
